summary: Gold Fields filed a Form 6-K furnishing its SENS announcement of Q3 2026 operational results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. Attributable gold-equivalent production was 605koz at an AISC of US$1,965/oz and AIC of US$2,266/oz, with Salares Norte producing 136koz at US$437/oz. The filing notes US$554 million of additional buybacks completed as at 3 November 2026, bringing total repurchases under the Additional Shareholder Returns Programme to US$854 million, plus Windfall's Certificate of Authorisation. No transaction, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed; net debt to adjusted EBITDA was 0.13x. Watch operating cost trends and buyback pace rather than deal terms.
